title: DuckDB – Data power tools for your laptop, now in Clojure (2023)
summary: This blog post from TechAscent introduces the DuckDB library for Clojure, enabling Clojure developers to leverage DuckDB's powerful in-process analytical SQL capabilities directly in their applications without requiring a separate database server.
problem_solved: Provides fast, embeddable OLAP database capabilities for Clojure applications running on laptops or local environments
why_valuable: Enables Clojure developers to perform analytical queries on local data with PostgreSQL-compatible SQL syntax while maintaining the benefits of an in-process, serverless database architecture
